manual_reads.coverage: Complete body personally read in contiguous ranges from 1-500 through 33901-34370; truncated tool passages were re-read in full before credit. External APIs/implementations, actual effects, libraries and devices are not credited.
interpretation: The graph and each option have distinct escaping layers; slash-prefixed option values load files. Automatic scaler/resampler insertion is semantic and must be frozen. FFmpeg may support cycles, while the application canonical media DAG must reject invalid cycles.
Timeline enable can bypass a processor; framesync defaults repeat secondary frames and use nearest-lower timestamp. Freeze EOF/repeat/sync policy explicitly.

Compressor/gate detector, channel-link, attack/release, makeup and mode affect state and audible output; metadata/labels are not DSP. Adaptive denoising and measured threshold modes require the correct upstream prefix.
Acrossfade sample-count versus duration precedence and overlap/curve selection affect exact length. Acrusher simulates quantization without changing actual sample bit depth.

AFIR IR normalization, per-channel linking, partition sizes, load timing and bounded duration affect gain, resources and latency. IR/model/ASR files and firequalizer dumpfiles are separate admitted opens.
Alimiter lookahead delay equals attack; latency compensation also flushes valid EOF audio. Reverse IIR block_size adds that many samples of delay and requires adequate impulse-response support.

Amerge may reorder channels and guess an arbitrary layout; amix is float-only, can auto-resample, normalizes by default and changes gain during dropout transition. Explicit routing and gain policies are mandatory.
Areverse buffers the whole clip; aloop and unconstrained apad can run indefinitely. Bound source windows/scratch and output extent rather than rely on filter defaults.
Asetnsamples defaults to zero-padding EOF, asetrate changes speed/pitch without changing PCM, while aresample may insert/drop samples to match timestamps. These are distinct sample/timing contracts.

Atrim timestamp constraints differ from counted samples and do not reset PTS; multiple constraints are greedy union, so intersection requires chaining. At tempo above 2, atempo skips samples; a selected high-quality route needs explicit decomposition and output oracles.

Dynaudnorm includes centered preceding/following frame windows, boundary gain assumptions, channel coupling and optional DC/compression; arbitrary chunk restarts do not preserve the declared processor.

Loudnorm linear mode can silently fall back to dynamic when measured constraints fail; dynamic true-peak processing upsamples to 192 kHz. The actual mode and output sample rate must be frozen/verified.
LADSPA/LV2 load executable plugins and search ambient library paths; model, HRIR/SOFA, dictionary, text and log destinations are explicit dependencies, not implied by a source-file grant.
Silencedetect reports interval start after a minimum detection delay; silenceremove can rewrite timestamps or retain holes. Canonical cut maps must transform dependent streams/captions exactly once.

Volume eval=once lacks time variables; frame-evaluated gain is not sample-accurate automation. ReplayGain side data is dropped by default; volumedetect forces signed 16-bit input and does not measure original high-precision peaks directly.
Whisper defaults use_gpu=true and can overwrite or network-write a destination; a CPU-only or granted-source route must explicitly disable GPU use and admit exact model/output dependencies.
Noise sources need explicit seed and finite duration. Generated source duration can end at a complete audio frame rather than the requested rational boundary.

addroi passes pixels unchanged but changes encoder side data. Temporal amplify/atadenoise require bounded neighboring-frame prefixes; bm3d search/group ranges need application resource limits tighter than native integer maxima.
ASS shaping depends on HarfBuzz-backed complex shaping and pinned fonts. Alpha reconstruction, blend plane units/framesync and black detection range/alpha modes are distinct media contracts.
Bwdif defaults send_field, all frames, and unknown parity falls back to top-field-first; a plan must record field/clock interpretation and verify output cadence.

Colordetect infers effective range/alpha from observed pixels, not original intent. Colorspace needs explicit characterized input; fast skips gamma/primary correction and is a changed approximation, not equivalent conversion.

RGB colorkey is 8-bit while chromakey uses YUV; channel/plane units and alpha association need a declared working representation. Colorlevels/curves can clip values and master curves apply a second mapping.
Crop rounds subsampled dimensions unless exact; keep_aspect changes SAR. Cropdetect defaults skip/round/history selection and is an analysis hint requiring a reviewed crop.

Cue uses wall-clock buffering without guaranteed frame accuracy. DCT denoise may leave borders unprocessed; decimate mixed creates VFR, and clean-source frame selection is distinct from processed metrics.

D3D12 custom deinterlacing is driver-defined and can need temporal references; CPU/GPU output equivalence is not implied. DNN backends have specific tensor ranks/layouts, device providers and async behavior; ONNX here is single-input synchronous NCHW float.

Drawtext text expansion can introduce wall-clock values and has separate escaping; freeze expansion mode, text/font bytes and shaping dependencies. Reloaded text/parameter failures retaining old state are not a valid committed edit result. Drawbox/grid default composition retains existing alpha unless replace=1.

Fade uses later-of-frame/time start and duration precedence; fieldmatch reconstructs fields but needs separate decimation. Detelecine needs the original pattern phase, and fieldorder shifts picture data rather than merely changing metadata.

FPS duplicates/drops with explicit PTS rounding/start/EOF; framerate interpolates and is not valid directly for interlaced inputs. AMF FRC may use future frames and a declared duplicate/blend fallback, so route/latency/objective must be qualified.
Geq expression state is per thread slice; stateful generated expressions need an explicit threading/seed policy. Missing alpha expressions can make output opaque.

Hald CLUT padding is ignored and last LUT can persist after EOF; guided fast is an approximation with subsampled guidance. Grayworld expects linear-light input. Hardware downloads/maps require exact supported formats and compatible devices, not a generic zero-copy assumption.

ICCdetection overwrites characterization tags by default and ICC generation may infer BT.709/sRGB; metadata defaults are not measured source characterization. Idet combines current/history classifications and can clear or trust flags after a finite analysis.

Lensfun resolves incomplete names to a best match and can load an ambient database; freeze exact resolved models/database bytes. Lens geometry correction and vignetting are different ordered operations.

Libplacebo can apply and strip film grain/Dolby Vision by default and resamples subsampled chroma even at unchanged dimensions. SAR normalization, format/alpha modes and view transform are explicit semantics.

Libplacebo peak detection is history-dependent, enabled by default and not written back as output metadata. Disable or qualify its prefix for deterministic seeks/exports. Shader caches are not automatically collected; custom shader/LUT files are admitted dependencies.

Tone/gamut algorithms, LUT interpretation, dithering and subjective color controls have distinct effects; conversion LUT can override ICC/tone/color settings. GPU/CPU emulation and round trips need actual objective/resource qualification.

VMAF requires explicit reference ordering, frame/time alignment, model/pool/subsample/thread policy and admitted log output. A perceptual score is not pixel/clock identity; the CUDA variant has separate surface/nonfree profile requirements.

LUT defaults clip to nominal component ranges; masks and plane merging use negotiated plane domains, not a generic normalized-alpha assumption. Minterpolate duplicates/blends/motion-compensates with explicit scene fallback and resource-heavy search.

Normalize smoothing and independent versus linked RGB channels affect temporal state and hue. OCIO can use ambient configuration and context-dependent file transforms; OCR/NNEDI/custom morphology need exact admitted data files.
Motion-vector side data and analysis scores require the right decoded representation and frame alignment; frame-drop and interpolation routes cannot be treated as preserved timing.

Overlay defaults to 8-bit 4:2:0 and auto alpha, repeats/synchronizes secondary input under framesync, and invalid positions can hide the overlay. Freeze working precision/alpha/clocks instead of silently accepting these defaults.

Premultiply_dynamic can choose premultiply/unpremultiply/no-op from downstream requirements; explicit association and identical picture formats are required. PSNR/SSIM compare frame pairs with equal resolution/format and are separate from timing/sample-count proofs.

Scale may convert format and changes SAR to preserve DAR; reset_sar, chroma siting, range, transfer, primaries, ICC intent, interlaced scaling and rational divisibility must be explicit. Perceptual ICC details can change with the component candidate.
Setfield/setparams/SAR tags alter interpretation without changing picture samples. Separatefields doubles cadence at half height; pullup consumes future field context and can drop frames.

Palette quantization/dithering/transparency thresholds change color/alpha; shader/model/font/LUT/bitmap/statistics files remain secondary opens. QR/text wall-clock and random expansion must not become nondeterministic export defaults.
The SITI implementation explicitly follows a superseded P.910 version; reporting must name that algorithm/version and not claim current-standard compliance from its filter name.
Subtitle burn original_size affects ASS aspect/font scaling; fontsdir supplements ambient font-provider inputs and wrap/shaping depends on exact component libraries.
Temporal medians/mixes, thumbnails, vidstab and vectorscope history consume lookback/lookahead; giant tile grids and tpad infinite modes need explicit checked extent and memory admission.
tinterlace changes cadence/geometry/field phase; trim counts versus timestamps and greedy unions do not reset clocks. tonemap needs linear float input and even none may still desaturate.

v360 projection/stereo/rotation order/padding/interpolation and zoompan previous-frame state/duration/FPS require explicit profiles. xfade requires identical geometry, format, frame rate and time base.
zscale input/output range, primaries, transfer, matrix, chroma location and nominal peak luminance are independent explicit conversion semantics.

CUDA/OpenCL require an identified matching device/frame layout and explicit uploads/downloads. colorspace_cuda only converts range; it is not equivalent to software colorspace. CUDA scaling cannot convert YUV to RGB, and passthrough versus allocated frames affects decoder pool pressure.

CUDA thumbnail batches retain frames; OpenCL deshake smoothing windows add memory/latency. program_opencl loads executable kernel source as an explicit dependency; its frame index is not an exact timeline clock.

OpenCL tonemap uses different desaturation and scene-adaptive running averages from CPU tonemap; identical filter names do not establish an equivalent objective. VAAPI HDR/HDR-to-SDR defaults and native scalers are explicit target contracts.
Vulkan nlmeans parallelism increases VRAM without guaranteed speed; hardware variant layout, precision, alpha and driver behavior require independent evidence.
Cellular/noise sources often default to random seeds and infinite extent. Video source duration rounds up to complete frame durations; nullsrc is unprocessed data, not a black generator.

Desktop capture selects native identities, has variable compositor timing and hardware surfaces. dup_frames, resize/crop/alpha modes are explicit live-source semantics; device grants and observations remain separate from ordinary media reads.
Concat pads shorter audio to the longest segment (except last), requires segment timestamps to start at zero, and may produce VFR. Splitting audio/video independently can desynchronize joins.

EBU R128 converts to double samples, metadata mode segments into 100 ms frames, and true peak requires oversampling. Scope displays, loudness and channel/dual-mono measurements are separate from sample/timing identity.
Interleave must queue at least one frame per input and may stall until EOF for a dropping source. Latency/alatency report previous-filter delay rather than whole application presentation latency.

Metadata print accepts writable URLs. sendcmd uses its own interval/target/command grammar and half-open intervals; those dynamic state changes need canonical sampled automation and prefix/seek rules.

Select uses frame-level samples/counts and can route negative/NaN to the first output; audio selection is not a substitute for exact sample trimming. setpts operates in the declared time base and optional strip_fps changes metadata.

Constant-Q/wavelet/FFT scopes have explicit windows, overlap, future support, averaging and precision. Whole-track picture scopes require bounded input/scratch; a perceptual display is not a reconstruction oracle.
spectrumsynth without phase recreates random phase and cannot prove audio identity. sidedata removal changes interpretation independently of picture/sample payload.

ZMQ filters create independent network listeners. movie/amovie can open devices/protocol URLs with independent format options and infinite loops without timestamp rebasing; these must never bypass explicit dependency/network/device admission.

donor_followup_reads.interpretation: Donor unknown-value parsing, complete stream categories, partial orders and estimated sizes must become strict typed observations and explicit confidence. Float parsing is behavioral evidence, not the selected exact-time representation.

Original extension and relative tree are retained by default; single-file suffixes, numbered collisions, nested-output rejection, companion discovery, exclusion pruning and truthful byte accounting need the shared authority/publication pipeline. Donor resolve/stat failures cannot prove path separation; normal filename generation cannot become implicit authorization.

The donor supplies progress-aware 4 MiB copy, best-effort access/modification times and companion counts. Its predictable partial deletion, replace-after-exists race and size-only copy checks are defects; Rust uses journal-owned staging, mandatory full bytes and atomic no-replace publication. Donor robocopy speed claims are not measured qualification. Copy deadline and truthful companion accounting remain required.

Every candidate, including probe failures and no-audio matches, contributes an explicit terminal result. Successful per-file byte deltas exclude skipped/failed source sizes. The donor rc=0 plus final.exists path can falsely credit old output; publication must use this attempt's verified staging and durable proof. Folder batching, separate companion outcomes, measured progress and complete failure/partial-result semantics remain required.

Scan inventory, case-insensitive unique language/title/codec summaries, original stream-index counts and per-file selection previews are product behavior. Shared typed paged projections must replace console-only reporting without losing unmatched files or confusing inventory with verification. Echo-to-log behavior must preserve privacy and bounded diagnostics; display colors are adapter presentation, not domain authority.
